assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or conduction abnormalities that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the patient's recurrent dizziness and giddiness in the context of the documented sick sinus syndrome and transient cerebral ischemic attacks
